description.value: Lord Byng Pool is a City of Vancouver public aquatic and recreation centre situated in the Point Grey neighbourhood. In addition to lap and recreational swimming, the facility features a hot tub and sauna, making it a worthwhile rest stop for cyclists looking to recover after a long ride. It is operated by the City of Vancouver Parks, Recreation and Culture department.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (16 spaces, covered) at 33m; stands (10 spaces) at 78m; stands (66 spaces) at 83m; stands (40 spaces) at 91m. Total: 132 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch failed with a Cloudflare block, so all evidence comes from OSM tags alone. OSM confirms a civic-building sports centre with swimming, hot_tub=yes, and sauna=yes, which strongly implies showers exist, but the rules require positive evidence and OSM has no explicit shower tag. No OSM tags address bike parking, water, or most other amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: Website fetch failed due to Cloudflare security block; all amenity claims rely solely on OSM tags and no contact details could be corroborated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible City of Vancouver aquatic facility. Hot tub and sauna make it a genuine draw for touring cyclists seeking recovery.

wow_evidence: City pool with hot tub and sauna — recovery ladder 1/2.
blurb: Point Grey pool with hot tub and sauna.
